parameters.query:
with ticket as (
  select ticket_id, customer_id
  from tickets
  where ticket_id = $1
  limit 1
), inserted as (
  insert into messages (
    customer_id,
    ticket_id,
    direction,
    channel,
    provider,
    idempotency_key,
    sender_role,
    body_text,
    payload_json,
    status
  )
  select
    customer_id,
    ticket_id,
    'outbound',
    'whatsapp',
    'operator-console-demo',
    $2,
    'staff',
    $3,
    $4::jsonb,
    'accepted'
  from ticket
  on conflict do nothing
  returning id, ticket_id, customer_id, created_at, true as inserted
), existing as (
  select id, ticket_id, customer_id, created_at, false as inserted
  from messages
  where idempotency_key = $2
    and not exists (select 1 from inserted)
  limit 1
), message_row as (
  select * from inserted
  union all
  select * from existing
), ticket_update as (
  update tickets
  set last_staff_reply_at = now(), updated_at = now(), status = 'awaiting_customer'
  where ticket_id = $1
    and exists (select 1 from message_row)
  returning ticket_id
), event_insert as (
  insert into event_log (type, ticket_id, customer_id, payload_json)
  select
    'console_staff_reply_recorded',
    ticket_id,
    customer_id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'source', 'operator-console',
      'clerk_user_id', $5,
      'idempotency_key', $2,
      'message_id', id,
      'inserted', inserted,
      'demo_delivery', 'db_only_no_twilio'
    )
  from message_row
  returning id
)
select
  true as ok,
  $1 as ticket_id,
  $2 as idempotency_key,
  id as message_id,
  inserted
from message_row;

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { ok: false, error: 'unauthorized', message: 'Unauthorized console reply webhook request' } }];

meta.description: Demo workflow. Console reply webhook -> env auth check -> validated request -> parameterized Postgres insert.
